purpose: The APB3 PULP SPI member of the real two-member OR group triggered alone must be uniquely attributed and its native pulse consumed through the verified declared-status read chain.
case_note: Same two-member group membership as joint-two-targets-ibex (identical members, ports, bases and trigger values), with the proven declared-irq-f5-apb-spi host pulse width of 16. Only INTCFG(0x24)=0x80000000 is written, so the SPI events_o pulse is the single active member and the idle timer never pulses. mstatus.MIE stays enabled (no gate) like the declared-irq-f5-apb-spi case, and the observed member's declared status register is INTSTA(0x28). The read re-arms the event and produces a real second native pulse during the ISR; the proven F5 width keeps it below MRET so the case still has exactly one take.
